activities.title: Moonvera Infra Private Limited and South West Energy Partners Discuss Tamil Nadu Investment Programme in Jakarta Indonesia
activities.description:
Moonvera Infra Private Limited, India, and South West Energy Partners LLC, USA, held discussions concerning the proposed Tamil Nadu Investment Programme, exploring potential avenues for international investment collaboration, project funding facilitation, infrastructure development, and sustainable economic growth across Tamil Nadu.

The discussions centred on identifying potential investment opportunities, developing structured project proposals, and exploring collaboration between international business partners and Indian project stakeholders. The initiative aims to examine opportunities that could contribute to the state’s economic development, strengthen infrastructure, support business expansion, and create long-term value for local communities.

Strengthening International Investment Collaboration

Moonvera Infra Private Limited works across project management, international business development and facilitation, investment advisory, and government project facilitation. Through its domestic presence and international business relationships, the company seeks to identify suitable projects and facilitate coordination between stakeholders.

South West Energy Partners LLC brings an international business perspective to the proposed collaboration. The discussions explored potential approaches to investment facilitation, project evaluation, financial structuring, and cross-border business cooperation, subject to due diligence, commercial agreements, and applicable regulatory requirements.

The proposed collaboration is intended to establish a structured approach to evaluating investment opportunities and determining how international business relationships may support eligible projects in Tamil Nadu.

Focus on Tamil Nadu’s Development Priorities

The discussions considered the potential for identifying suitable projects across infrastructure and other development-oriented sectors, depending on project readiness, investment feasibility, and the relevant authorities’ priorities.

activities.title: Discussion and progress discussion with Honorable Minister D. Sarath Kumar (Minister for Human Resources Management, Government of Tamil Nadu)
activities.description: தமிழ்நாடு அரசின் திட்டங்களுக்கும் தமிழ்நாடு அரசின் ஆக்கபூர்வமான முன்னெடுப்பிற்கும் South West Energy Partners LLC (USA & Moonvera Infra Private Limited நிறுவனத்தின் மூலம்  முதலீட்டு வாய்ப்பை உருவாக்கிக்கொடுக்கும் முன்னெடுப்பாக முதலீடு திட்டத்திற்கான முன்னெடுப்பிற்காக  Detailed Project Report (DPR) மாண்புமிகு தமிழக அமைச்சர் திரு சரத் (Minister for Human Resources Management, Government of Tamil Nadu) அவர்களின் மூலமாக தமிழக அரசின் கவனத்திற்கு கொண்டுசெல்வதற்க்காக திட்ட அறிக்கையை மாண்புமிகு அமைச்சர் அவர்களிடம் தெரிவித்து கலந்துரையாடல் நடைபெற்றது.
